# doc-section-diff

> Compare two versions of a Markdown document section by section with stable section ids and content hashes, and report what a RAG index must add, drop, rename or re-embed. Python package `trysac-doc-section-diff`, import name `doc_section_diff`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): parsing, ids, hashes and diff algorithm
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): the tests in `tests/test_doc_section_diff.py`
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Project record](docs/PROJECT.md): scope and out-of-scope
